policy: Only explicit machine-local absolute prefixes are replaced; numeric fields, SHA values, URLs, repo-relative inventory keys and all original whitespace are retained.
receipt_hash_semantics: Hashes inside copied receipts continue to bind original private streams; public derivative hashes are recorded separately in evidence-inventory.json.
replay_limit: Redacted paths are descriptive labels, not runnable paths. Temporary checkouts were removed normally after review; original external declarations/context/raw remain private.
